queries_run: Lodging supply growth 2026 2027 structural or cyclical oversupply US hotel
Lodging supply discipline new construction pipeline timeline hotel 2027
Hilton Worldwide Holdings demand outlook 2026 RevPAR guidance third quarter
US hotel demand outlook 2027 2028 forecast CoStar STR Tourism Economics

findings.claim: CoStar/Tourism Economics Aug 2026 forecast: US supply growth 0.4% in 2026 and 0.6% in 2027, construction volume lowest in 12 years; 2026 RevPAR +4.4%, 2027 +2.1%; June 2027 RevPAR -0.8% on World Cup comp. No 2028 forecast found.
findings.source: CoStar U.S. Hotel Forecast Assumptions – August 2026

findings.claim: Lodging Econometrics Q3 2026: 2027 US openings forecast 668 hotels/72,667 rooms (+1.3% supply), revised down from 824 hotels in Q4 2025 report; under-construction 1,094 projects/137,371 rooms; project announcements recovering.
findings.source: Lodging Econometrics U.S. construction pipeline reports (Q3 2026 / Q4 2025)

findings.claim: PwC Dec 2025 outlook expected supply growth to outpace demand in 2026, though supply remained below long-term averages (dissenting view).
findings.source: PwC US Hospitality Directions via Hotel Dive

findings.claim: Hilton Q3 2026 (8-K, Oct 27 2026): system-wide comparable RevPAR +5.8%; FY2026 RevPAR guidance raised to 4%-4.5% from 3%-3.5%; Q4 guide +3%-3.5%; Middle East war and midterms cited as Q4 impacts; adjusted EBITDA guidance trimmed slightly.

supply_demand_durability.note: Excerpts not verbatim (only search summaries seen). Sources conflict on supply growth: STR 0.4/0.6% vs LE ~1.3%. CEO 2027 RevPAR 3-4% claim came from an AI brief, not included.
